citation.authors: Dorogovtsev VN, Yankevich DS, Goswami N
citation.title: Effects of an Innovative Head-Up Tilt Protocol on Blood Pressure and Arterial Stiffness Changes

population.description: Forty young healthy volunteers, 23 men and 17 women (Table 1; Methods), without arterial hypertension, atherosclerosis or diabetes mellitus, with clinical and biochemical blood tests within normal limits (Methods). Age 25.1 +/- 2.64 y and BMI 24.7 +/- 3.6 kg/m2 are mean and SD for all 40 (Table 1, 'M +/- SD'). The Abstract's 20-32 y is an enrolment-style range and is not used; min and max are null.

protocols.name: supine_rest
protocols.description: Lying supine (the paper's 'horizontal supine 1', Abstract; Table 2 'Horizontal 1') after 10 min of rest in the horizontal position, before any tilt; values averaged over minutes 6 to 10 of that block (Methods). Arm minutes 0 to 10: duration 11 = the 10-min block with minute 10 held, so the averaged minutes 6 to 10 are simulated. No tilt. No meal and no fasting time printed; fed state not stated, so init norm_center with no meal (coordinator rule for heart and circulation; markers are BP and HR only). Clock hour not printed (experiments 8:00 to 11:30 a.m., Methods): 8.0 assumed.

findings.description: Systolic BP lying supine (horizontal 1), mean over minutes 6 to 10 of the 10-min rest, n=40, mean +/- SD

location.where: Table 2, column 'Horizontal 1', row 'SBP mmHg' (Measuring Units header: 'M +/- SD')

findings.description: Diastolic BP lying supine (horizontal 1), mean over minutes 6 to 10 of the 10-min rest, n=40, mean +/- SD

location.where: Table 2, column 'Horizontal 1', row 'DBP mmHg' (Measuring Units header: 'M +/- SD')

findings.description: Heart rate lying supine (horizontal 1), mean over minutes 6 to 10 of the 10-min rest, n=40, mean +/- SD. The paper prints the unit as 'b/min' (beats per minute); entered as beats/min, the loader's spelling of the same unit

location.where: Table 2, column 'Horizontal 1', row 'HR b/min' (Measuring Units header: 'M +/- SD')

left_out.what: Standardised HUTT (tilted) column of Table 2: SBP, DBP, HR, SV, CO, TVR and PWV during the individual tilt (Table 2; Results 3.1-3.2)
Horizontal 2 column of Table 2: SBP, DBP, HR, SV, CO, TVR and PWV, supine again after the 10-min tilt (Table 2; Methods)

Group-mean change on tilt, delta SBP and delta DBP each -1.9 mmHg, and the orthostatic classes by delta SBP (48%, 32%, 20%; Abstract, Results 3.2): tilt differences, the second with no uncertainty printed

Venous pressure in the great saphenous vein, horizontal and during HUTT 30 and 70 degrees (Discussion 4.2): the model has no venous pressure series (the tilt values would also need posture); no n printed and not clearly this study's own measurement
Pulse wave velocity, horizontal 1 (Table 2: 6.2 +/- 0.6 m/s; Results 3.2)
PWV in healthy subjects with and without orthostatic disturbance, horizontal and tilt (Results 3.2: 6.2 +/- 0.7 vs 6.2 +/- 0.4; 8.0 +/- 1.1 vs 7.8 +/- 0.42 m/s)
